_about: The room narrator's lines (see docs/voice-lines.md). `npm run voice` generates every take into public/media/audio/room/ and writes manifest.json. A take is text, or { text, sfx, at } to layer a sound effect `at` seconds into it.
_voice: Chris - Warm, Friendly, and Engaging (Voice Library), as in the opening: eleven_v3, stability 100%, similarity 100%

arrive-first: [chuckles] Make yourself at home. Shoes optional.
Click on anything. [playfully] I promise I won't bite.
arrive-return: [delighted] You're back! I knew you'd come back.
Oh, hello again. [chuckles] Couldn't stop thinking about that kitchen, could you?
Welcome back. [playfully] I kept everything exactly where you left it.
Back so soon? [laughs] I'll pretend I'm not flattered.
arrive-morning: Up early? [warmly] Coffee and kitchens. My favourite combination.
arrive-afternoon: Perfect time for a little daydreaming. [softly] Go on, look around.
arrive-evening: Long day? [softly] Put your feet up. Let's talk kitchens.
arrive-night: [whispers] Late-night kitchen planning? The best ideas show up after dark.
idle-20s: [whispers] Psst… the kitchen's clickable, you know.
Go on, click something. [chuckles] I promise nothing breaks.
[curious] Thinking? Take your time… or click the kitchen. Either works.
Not sure where to start? [playfully] The kitchen. It's always the kitchen.
idle-60s: Still there? [whispers] I can hear you thinking.
[sighs] Don't mind me… just waiting for you to click something.
[chuckles] You've been staring at that wall for a while. It's a good wall.
Hellooo? [laughs] Okay, okay… I'll be quiet.
kitchen-first: It's me again. [chuckles] So you finally made it. [playfully] Try the different colours… and the different angles too. Don't hold back.
[excited] Ah, the kitchen! My favourite room. Pick a finish down below, go wild.
Here we are. [playfully] Every colour down there is a kitchen we've actually built. Try them on.
[warmly] Pull up a stool. Now… hover over anything, and I'll tell you what it's made of.

kitchen-second.text: I see you're getting used to it… How's it going so far?

kitchen-second: Back in the kitchen? [chuckles] Told you. It's always the kitchen.
Oh, round two. [playfully] Found your colour yet?
kitchen-again: At this point you're basically family. [laughs] Help yourself.
Third time's the charm. [playfully] Shall we just build it?
[whispers] I won't tell anyone how often you come in here.
kitchen-materials: Go on, explore. [whispers] Quartz on top, oak underneath.
[curious] Hover around. I'll tell you what everything's made of.
Every material here is something we really use.
finish-first: See? Same kitchen, whole new mood.
finish-sage: Sage and oak. [softly] Calm, warm… very you.
Sage. [chuckles] The colour of people who own good olive oil.
Classic sage. It never goes out of style.
finish-forest: Forest green. [approvingly] Bold. I like you already.
Ooh, forest green. That's the one everybody asks about.
[playfully] Deep green and walnut… someone has taste.
finish-white: Warm white… feels like a Sunday morning, doesn't it?
The safe choice? [chuckles] No. The smart one.
finish-greige: Greige. [playfully] Not grey, not beige… perfectly in between.
A little greige, just like I said. [chuckles] I knew it.
finish-terracotta: [laughs] Terracotta! Now that's a seventies kitchen.
Retro terracotta… my grandmother would approve.
kitchen-indecisive: Can't decide? [laughs] Neither can most of our clients.
[playfully] Take your time. They all look good on you.
Tell you what… we can mix them. Just ask.
[chuckles] Okay, okay. Don't wear out the swatches.
kitchen-linger: You've been here a while. [warmly] When you're ready, build this kitchen is right there.
Seeing yourself in it yet? [softly] That's how it starts.
Good kitchens are never rushed… but they do get built. Bottom right.
gallery-first: [excited] Ahh, yes! Our gallery. You can see the full one on our official page… just click through!
Real kitchens, real homes. [proudly] All built right here in Tbilisi.
[playfully] These four are just the warm-up. The full gallery's one click away.
Ooh, take a look. [softly] Every one of these started as a sketch, just like this room.
gallery-again: Back for another look? [chuckles] Spotted a favourite yet?
They don't get old, do they?
[playfully] Tell me which one, and I'll pretend I'm not biased.
gallery-leave: Off you go! [chuckles] Come back and tell me.
door-walk: Mind the sawdust. [chuckles] This is where it all gets made.
[proudly] Welcome to the workshop. Every piece starts right here.
Smell that? [inhales] Fresh oak. Best smell in the world.
Careful, it's a bit messy. [laughs] Creative people, you know.
This is us. [warmly] Let me introduce you properly.
door-again: Back in the workshop? [laughs] You'll be asking for a job next.
Couldn't get enough of the sawdust, eh?
door-stay: Changed your mind? [laughs] The door's always open.
Fair enough. Plenty to see out here.
[chuckles] Not ready to meet the team? That's okay.
tv-hover: [whispers] Psst… this is where we talk.

contacts-click.text: Let's talk. [warmly] I'll put the kettle on.

contacts-click: [excited] Oh, good! Let's make it happen.
Smart move. We'll be in touch.
swipe-all: Seen the whole place. [curious] So… where to?
That's the grand tour. [chuckles] Pick a corner.
Every corner covered. Now for the fun part.
time-1min: One whole minute. [chuckles] You're comfortable, aren't you?
[softly] Nice in here, isn't it? No rush.
time-3min: Three minutes in. [laughs] Should I start charging rent?
You know, most people just look. You're actually thinking about it.
time-5min: Honestly? [laughs] You might as well design the whole house. Contacts is by the TV.
Five minutes. [warmly] I think you've found your kitchen.
Okay, I'm convinced. You're ready. Let's talk.
tab-return: Oh, you're back! [chuckles] I thought you'd left me.
[playfully] Welcome back. I didn't touch anything.
There you are. Showing someone? [laughs] Tell them I said hi.
replay-intro: You liked that, huh? Here we go.

bell.text: A single bright brass service bell ding on a counter, short and clean, dry room

door-creak.text: An old wooden door slowly creaking open, short, dry indoor room

kettle.text: An electric kettle switch clicking on, then soft water starting to heat
